PostDoc in Multilayer Meta-Optics for High-Performance Optical Systems Postdoc to design, fabricate & test multilayer/hybrid meta-optics: full-wave/inverse design, EBL/deposition/RIE, broadband optical characterization & fiber coupling.

Postdoctoral Researcher – Tactile Sensing for Dexterous Manipulation Lead design/fabrication of compact multi-axis tactile sensors for dexterous robotic hands; integrate and benchmark closed-loop control; co-supervise students; publish top robotics work.

Postdoc in gears - manufacturing to performance Postdoc: study how manufacturing and geometry/surface variations affect gear efficiency, wear and life. Run FZG rig experiments, surface/geometry metrology; explore new materials and lubrication.

Postdoctoral Researcher in EMT Simulation & Scientific Software Fully funded postdoc to advance BriskSim for EMT & power-system dynamics. Build scalable simulation algorithms and modern scientific software (C++/Julia/Rust/Python), collaborate with industry.

Postdoc in X-ray and neutron characterization of metals for AM Develop in-/ex-situ synchrotron & neutron methods at PETRA III (P21.2) to study laser/e-beam processed metals for AM/welding; analyze microstructure, phase changes & properties.

Post-doc Position Advanced Electrochemical Processing of Wide-Bandgap Semiconductors Postdoc 40h/week (1 year + possible 2-year extension): electrochemical processing of SiC (porous, polishing, oxidation) and high-temp treatments; publish and co-supervise students.

Scientist (f/m/div) in the Area Resource-Efficient Controlled Environment Horticulture Postdoc role developing sensor- & model-based (AI/Digital Twin) strategies to optimize resource-efficient greenhouse/indoor crops. 3+3 yrs, TV-L E13, 32h+ / up to 50% remote.

Two Postdoctoral Researchers in Memristor Materials and Devices 2 postdoc tracks: memristor crossbar fabrication/reliability or perovskite quantum-dot nanomaterials for memristive devices. Strong experimental microfab or synthesis skills needed.

Postdoc position at the Leiden Institute of Physics (LION) 2-year full-time postdoc in Leiden developing graphene edge-to-edge tunneling sensors + microfluidics for single-molecule detection/sequencing. Requires nanofabrication/2D materials publications.

Postdoctoral Researcher in Multiphysics Modelling of High-Temperature Superconductor Quench Protection Develop and validate FEM/multiphysics models of quench behavior in YBCO HTS tapes/coils; simulate current diverters, propose safer architectures, publish results. 2-year postdoc.

Postdoctoral Researcher (ORBIT Consortium, Management and Organizations) 3-year postdoc in ORBIT studying responsible AI in Nordic energy smart grids. Do qualitative fieldwork, comparative analyses & co-author publications; travel across Nordic countries.
